Opt in to compare weekly activity, nutrition, consistency, and hydration milestones. Your private Progress screen stays available without joining.

Fud AI calculates everything on your device. It uploads only the week start, overall points, qualifying activity, nutrition, consistency and hydration day counts, and total activity calories. Food names, meals, weight, workout details, and Health Connect records are never uploaded.
Only your display name and optional single X or Instagram handle are visible to participants. Weight and weight loss are never ranked.

Activity: a day with a positive logged workout burn. Nutrition: daily calories within 85–115% of your goal. Consistency: any food logged that day. Hydration: water goal met when tracking is enabled. Overall: the four day counts added together, up to 28.
